_doc: A run registry: copy it beside server.py as runs.json (git ignores that name), or anywhere and pass --runs. The fields are in README.md.

runs.title: Training the star remover on a synthetic sky that follows the nebula's own structure (R2e)
runs.what: One model, seed 0, trained until its validation loss stops improving (patience 24, cap 240,000 steps)
runs.question: Does steering the synthetic texture along the nebula's own filaments keep the bright-star gain without costing faint stars?
runs.setup: Truth plates from the synthetic background export; the same sessions, cells, stars and noise as arm B.
predictions: Bright stars stay repaired: clean removal at 100-1000 sigma at least A's control (24.4 %).
The steer costs no faint stars: clean removal at 5-20 sigma within 3.1 points of A's control (73.0 %).
runs.kill: Under A's control by more than 5 points at 5-20 sigma, or by more than 4.6 at 100-1000.

runs.title: Filling star holes with drawn texture: does it put the sky back? (hole-fill check on 8 plates)
Re-scoring the earlier models without the validation night that overlaps training

scores.name: Every star remover scored so far, on the validation draws
